prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1423; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the parking lot collision you were involved in in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was pulling out of a parking space at the shopping center. I checked my mirrors and started backing slowly. Another car came down the lane pretty fast and clipped the rear corner of my vehicle.

Q: Had you come to a complete stop before you began backing?

A: I was already moving, but I was going very slowly, maybe a few miles an hour.

Q: Where was your vehicle when the impact happened?

A: Still in the lane behind my space, about halfway out. The other driver was coming from my left.

Q: Did you or the other driver sound a horn or brake before impact?

A: I didn't hear a horn. I think they braked at the last second, but it was too late.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away. I felt a jolt and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the accident?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes, the stiffness is still there, especially when I sit for long periods or turn my head quickly. I've been doing some physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Not that I can think of. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
